Here’s a quick “starter‑pack” of Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering solid vegetarian options. All of them are in the city proper (not the suburbs) and have a reputation for good food, friendly service, and a menu that can accommodate a plant‑based diet. | # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes | |---|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------| | 1 | **Siam Thai** | 1234 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | • Pad Thai (tofu)
• Green Curry (tofu & veggies)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Fresh Spring Rolls (veggie) | One of the most popular Thai chains in Chicago. They have a dedicated vegetarian menu on the table and a “vegetarian” icon on the menu. | | 2 | **Baan Thai** | 5678 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | • Tofu Pad Krapow
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Veggie Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | Known for generous portions and a relaxed vibe. They offer a “vegetarian” section on the menu and can accommodate special requests. | | 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 9100 W. 31st St., Chicago, IL 60625 | (312) 555‑9012 | • Pad Thai (tofu)
• Red Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Kha Gai (veggie version)
• Fresh Spring Rolls | A family‑owned spot that prides itself on authentic flavors. Their vegetarian menu is clearly marked and they’re happy to swap out meats. | | 4 | **Siam Thai (West Loop)** | 3450 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑3456 | • Pad Thai (tofu)
• Green Curry (vegetarian)
• Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian)
• Veggie Spring Rolls | The West Loop location is a bit more upscale but still offers the same great vegetarian options. | | 5 | **Thai House** | 1122 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1122 | • Tofu Pad Krapow
• Massaman Curry (vegetarian)
• Veggie Spring Rolls
• Vegetarian Fried Rice | A newer spot that’s quickly become a favorite for its fresh ingredients and vegetarian-friendly menu. | ### How to pick the right one | Factor | What to look for | |--------|------------------| | **Location** | If you’re in the Loop or West Loop, Siam Thai (West Loop) or Thai House are convenient. For a quieter neighborhood feel, Baan Thai or Thai Orchid are great. | | **Ambiance** | Siam Thai is a chain with a consistent vibe; Baan Thai and Thai Orchid feel more local and cozy. | | **Menu depth** | Siam Thai and Baan Thai have the most extensive vegetarian sections, while Thai Orchid offers a smaller but still solid selection. | | **Price** | All are mid‑range (average $15–$25 per dish). | ### Quick order‑up tips 1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “veggie”** – most staff will automatically switch out meats for tofu or extra veggies. 2. **Look for the “vegetarian” icon** on the menu – it usually indicates dishes that are already meat‑free. 3. **Request no fish sauce** if you’re avoiding all animal products; most places can accommodate. Enjoy your Thai adventure! If you’d like a reservation or more detailed menu info, let me know and I can help you call ahead.
